svg.title: Competition Programs: Draft, Publish and Athlete Schedule — code design
svg.desc: Admin / Coach: edit and publish; nominated Athlete: published views only. SUNNY: Meet -> Program -> instructions -> add valid day -> event/category/round -> times or TBC + location -> save draft -> Preview -> Publish -> athlete views Full Program / My Schedule. EVENT SHORTCUT: missing event -> + Add Event -> existing create workflow -> return and refresh options; cancellation returns without creating an event or clearing the session form. VALIDATION: reject out-of-range date, missing event/round/location, mismatched event/category, and Publish with no session; surface errors so staff can correct input. DELETION: confirm removes day + its instructions/sessions from draft; cancel preserves all content. Confirm session deletion separately. ISOLATION / FAILURE: edits after Publish remain draft until Republish; athletes cannot edit or read drafts. Failed saves show unsaved state and retry; stale revisions cannot silently overwrite newer changes.

Admin / Coach: edit and publish; nominated Athlete: published views only
E = existing source | P = proposed component/contract | EXTEND = existing code + planned changes | solid = request/data flow | dashed = response
+ Add Event preserves meet and session form;
return or cancel without losing input
Athlete: Full Program / My Schedule, read-only
PUT draft owns nested day/session create, update and delete
Program classes and routes are new.
Publish emits a durable notification trigger
[P] Read draft; validate and save aggregate; publish

[P] Validate every day/session ID belongs to this draft
saveDraft(): transaction + optimistic revision check; never overwrite
Validate dates inside Meet.startDate..endDate; event belongs to selected
Require event, round and location; each report/start time is a value OR
publish(): require >= 1 day with >= 1 valid session; atomically store
mySchedule(): published sessions joined to own assignments; preserve TBC and
Save acknowledgment returned only after commit
Preview uses the current draft after a successful save
No draft fields appear in portal responses
Failed autosave keeps local edits and shows retry;
publishing waits for a successful save
[P] Lock/check draft revision; persist nested days and sessions atomically
[P] Day removal cascades only its draft content
[P] Publish snapshot and pointer in one transaction
[P] Publication event outbox saved with snapshot
[P] ProgramSession: day_id FK, event_id FK, round,
reportTime / startTime nullable with separate TBC
Snapshot retained across later draft edits or draft
Version-qualified session IDs support links from

EVENT SHORTCUT: missing event -> + Add Event -> existing create workflow -> return and refresh options; cancellation returns without creating an event or clearing the session form.
VALIDATION: reject out-of-range date, missing event/round/location, mismatched event/category, and Publish with no session; surface errors so staff can correct input.
DELETION: confirm removes day + its instructions/sessions from draft; cancel preserves all content. Confirm session deletion separately.
ISOLATION / FAILURE: edits after Publish remain draft until Republish; athletes cannot edit or read drafts. Failed saves show unsaved state and retry; stale revisions cannot silently overwrite newer
